35852-in-the-year-13-a-tale-of-mecklenbu.title: Tale Of Mecklenburg Life
35852-in-the-year-13-a-tale-of-mecklenbu.creator: Unknown
35852-in-the-year-13-a-tale-of-mecklenbu.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ing story, called in the original "Ut de Franzosentid", was published in 1860, and rapidly passed through several editions. It is one of a series to which Reuter has given the name of "Olle Kamellen" literally "old camomile-flowers", by which he means "old tales, old recollections, useful as homely remedies." It is one of the most popular of his works, and perhaps also the most translateable. Hence the reason for bringing it first before the English public.

arxiv-2205-15773.title: Hyperbolic Anderson model 2: Strichartz estimates and Stratonovich setting
arxiv-2205-15773.creator: Xia Chen, Aurélien Deya, Jian Song, Samy Tindel
arxiv-2205-15773.description: Abstract . We study a wave equation in dimension d ∈ { 1 , 2 } d\in\{1,2\} with a multiplicative space-time Gaussian noise. The existence and uniqueness of the Stratonovich solution is obtained under some conditions imposed on the Gaussian noise.

arxiv-2306-07255.title: Conditional Matrix Flows for Gaussian Graphical Models
arxiv-2306-07255.creator: Marcello Massimo Negri, Fabricio Arend Torres, Volker Roth
arxiv-2306-07255.description: Abstract Studying conditional independence among many variables with few observations is a challenging task. Gaussian Graphical Models (GGMs) tackle this problem by encouraging sparsity in the precision matrix through l q l_{q} regularization with q ≤ 1 q\leq 1 .

arxiv-2402-17918.title: The Seeker’s Dilemma: Realistic Formulation and Benchmarking for Hardware Trojan Detection
arxiv-2402-17918.creator: Amin Sarihi, Ahmad Patooghy, Abdel-Hameed A. Badawy, Peter Jamieson
arxiv-2402-17918.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Amin Sarihi, Ahmad Patooghy, Abdel-Hameed A. Badawy, Peter Jamieson. This work focuses on advancing security research in the hardware design space by formally defining the realistic problem of Hardware Trojan (HT) detection. The goal is to model HT detection more closely to the real world, i.e. , describing the problem as “The Seeker’s Dilemma” (an extension of Hide&Seek on a graph), where a detecting agent is unaware of whether circuits are infected by HTs or not.

arxiv-2505-16898.title: Active Quantum Reservoir Engineering: Using a Qubit to Manipulate its Environment
arxiv-2505-16898.creator: Marcelo Janovitch, Matteo Brunelli, Patrick P. Potts
arxiv-2505-16898.description: Abstract Quantum reservoir engineering leverages dissipative processes to achieve desired behavior, with applications ranging from entanglement generation to quantum error correction. Therein, a structured environment acts as an entropy sink for the system and no time-dependent control over the system is required.

arxiv-2511-07389.title: Isaacs’ Generalization of Taketa’s theorem
arxiv-2511-07389.creator: Xiaoyou Chen, Mark L. Lewis
arxiv-2511-07389.description: Abstract . We generalize the definition of pseudo monomial characters and M M -groups to the Brauer character and Isaacs’ π \pi -partial character settings. We prove an analogs of Isaacs’s generalization of Taketa’s theorem in those settings. We consider other analogs of results regarding M M -groups in those settings. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 20C20; Secondary 20C15 1.

arxiv-2601-05479.title: Homological obstructions for regular embeddings of graphs
arxiv-2601-05479.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by . In [ 36 , Section 8] , the present author proposed the hypergraph obstruction for the existence of k k -regular embeddings. In this paper, we develop the hypergraph obstruction concretely and give some homological obstructions for the k k -regular embeddings of graphs by using the embedded homology of sub-hypergraphs of the ( k − 1 ) (k-1) -skeleton of the independence complexes.

britannica-1911-beaugency.title: Beaugency (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-beaugency.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-beaugency.description: Article 'Beaugency' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 3), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The lords of Beaugency attained considerable importance in the 11th, 12th and 13th centuries; at the end of the 13th century the fief was sold to the crown, and afterwards passed to the house of Orleans, then to those of Dunois and Longueville and  ultimately again to that of Orleans. Joan of Arc defeated the English here in 1429.

europmc-pmc8940982.creator: Fang E, Liu X, Li M, Zhang Z, Song L, Zhu B, Wu X, Liu J, Zhao D, Li Y.
europmc-pmc8940982.description: To date, the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) has determined 399,600,607 cases and 5,757,562 deaths worldwide. COVID-19 is a serious threat to human health globally. The World Health Organization (WHO) has

pmc-10781918.title: A Noninvasive Approach to Evaluate Tumor Immune Microenvironment and Predict Outcomes in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-10781918.creator: Jianmin Wu, Wanmin Liu, Xinyao Qiu, Jing Li, Kairong Song, Siyun Shen, Lei Huo, Lu Chen, Mingshuang Xu, Hongyang Wang, Ningyang Jia, Lei Chen
pmc-10781918.description: It is widely recognized that tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) plays a crucial role in tumor progression, metastasis, and therapeutic response. Despite several noninvasive strategies have emerged for cancer diagnosis and prognosis, there are still lack of effective radiomic-based model to evaluate TIME status, let alone predict clinical outcome and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICIs) response for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

pmc-11506219.title: Clinical Insights and Future Prospects: A Comprehensive Narrative Review on Immunomodulation Induced by Electrochemotherapy
pmc-11506219.creator: Martina Ferioli, Anna Myriam Perrone, Pierandrea De Iaco, Arina A. Zamfir, Gloria Ravegnini, Milly Buwenge, Bruno Fionda, Erika Galietta, Costanza M. Donati, Luca Tagliaferri, Alessio G. Morganti
pmc-11506219.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Electrochemotherapy (ECT) is an emerging therapeutic approach gaining growing interest for its potential immunomodulatory effects in cancer treatment. This narrative review systematically examines the current state of knowledge regarding the interplay between ECT and the immune system. Through an analysis of preclinical and clinical studies, the review highlights ECT capacity to induce immunogenic cell death, activate dendritic cells, release tumor antigens, trigger inflammatory responses, and occasionally manifest systemic effects—the abscopal phenomenon.

pmc-11669987.title: Exosomes derived from microRNA-540-3p overexpressing mesenchymal stem cells promote immune tolerance via the CD74/nuclear factor-kappaB pathway in cardiac allograft
pmc-11669987.creator: Ji-Gang He, Xin-Xin Wu, Si Li, Dan Yan, Gao-Peng Xiao, Fu-Gang Mao
pmc-11669987.description: BACKGROUNDHeart transplantation is a crucial intervention for severe heart failure, yet the challenge of organ rejection is significant. Bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) and their exosomes have demonstrated potential in modulating T cells, dendtitic cells (DCs), and cytokines to achieve immunomodulatory effects.

pmc-12565549.title: Acute Coronary Syndrome in Intensive Care Unit Patients: Troponin or Triglyceride Glucose Index Levels?
pmc-12565549.creator: Özgen Şafak, Mehmet Tolga Hekim, Didar Elif Akgün
pmc-12565549.description: Background and Objectives: There are few studies suggesting that the Triglyceride–Glucose Index (TyG), which is mostly defined as a predictor of diabetes, can be used as a predictor of coronary artery disease. In this study, we investigated the relationship between TyG index and acute coronary syndrome (ACS).

pmc-12682491.title: A dual-branch network for lesion segmentation in medical images using state space models
pmc-12682491.creator: Hao Chen, Byung-Won Min, Haifei Zhang
pmc-12682491.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundLesion segmentation in medical images is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning. However, existing methods often struggle to effectively extract both local and global features, limiting segmentation accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose a dual-branch network that integrates state space models (SSMs) with deep convolutional networks to enhance the extraction of both local and global features, thus improving lesion segmentation performance.MethodsThe proposed model employs a dual-branch encoder: one branch incorporates the visual state space encoder to efficiently model long-range contextual

pmc-12737672.title: Characterization of Novel Przondovirus Phage Adeo Infecting Klebsiella pneumoniae of the K39 Capsular Type
pmc-12737672.creator: Nadezhda V. Kolupaeva, Peter V. Evseev, Victoria A. Avdeeva, Angelika A. Sizova, Natalia E. Suzina, Nikolay V. Volozhantsev, Anastasia V. Popova
pmc-12737672.description: Klebsiella pneumoniae is one of the most significant nosocomial pathogens and an important cause of human infections worldwide. The microorganism is capable of producing different capsular polysaccharides (CPSs), which are the primary receptors for capsule-specific K. pneumoniae bacteriophages encoding tailspike proteins (TSPs) with polysaccharide-degrading activity. In this study, the novel virulent Przondovirus phage Adeo was isolated and characterized.

pmc-12746276.title: Association between simultaneous exposure to socioeconomic disadvantages and cardiovascular health of Brazilian adolescents
pmc-12746276.creator: Priscila Bárbara Zanini Rosa, Felipe Vogt Cureau, Beatriz D. Schaan, Juliana Sena de Souza, Michele Drehmer
pmc-12746276.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionSocioeconomic inequities affect cardiovascular outcomes in adults, but their cumulative effect in adolescents remains unclear. The aim of this study is to evaluate the association between simultaneous exposure to different socioeconomic disadvantages and cardiovascular health (CVH) in Brazilian adolescents.MethodsThe sample consisted of 34,831 adolescents aged 12 to 17 years, participants of the Brazilian Cardiovascular Risk in Adolescents Study (ERICA), a national, school-based, cross-sectional, multicenter study.

pmc-13063611.title: Ten years of screen time among medical students in Dresden, Germany: unveiling the trends
pmc-13063611.creator: Lukas Liebig, Willy Gräfe, Nicholas Lynch, Mandy Gottschall, Béla Birkás, Erika Balogh, Nora Faubl, Erika Zelko, Henna Riemenschneider
pmc-13063611.description: IntroductionScreen time has become an integral part of academic and private life, especially for medical students, whose daily routines increasingly depend on digital devices. Prolonged screen time is associated with negative health outcomes. There is no long-term data on trends in screen time among medical students in Germany.

pmc-13195994.title: Evaluation of the effectiveness of nutrition education program in promoting healthy dietary habits in Memphis, Tennessee: a quasi-experimental pilot study
pmc-13195994.creator: Edmore Madondo, Sharon Moore, Gabriella Huffstetler, Elaina Kaufman, Butch Odom, Kimberly Boone, Fawaz Mzayek, Debra Bartelli
pmc-13195994.description: BackgroundPoor diet is a major public health concern due to its association with chronic diseases. Church Health, a not-for-profit and faith-based healthcare organization in Memphis, Tennessee, implemented Cook Well, Be Well (CWBW), a 4-session nutrition education program designed to improve dietary habits through instruction on the Mediterranean diet (MD), the Model for Healthy Living (MFHL), and healthy cooking.

pmc-13209929.title: The Far-IR Fe–Cp Vibrations of Deuterated Ferrocene: A DFT Benchmark and Physics-Based AI Assessment
pmc-13209929.creator: Feng Wang, Vladislav Vasilyev
pmc-13209929.description: Deuteration provides a controlled perturbation for probing isotope and symmetry effects in organometallic vibrational spectra. Here, density functional theory (DFT) is used to systematically examine the evolution of far-infrared (400–600 cm−1) Fe–Cp vibrational modes in fully protonated, partially deuterated, and fully deuterated ferrocene.

pmc-13234147.title: Awareness of oral health, hygiene practices, and chemotherapy-related oral manifestations among parents of pediatric oncology patients
pmc-13234147.creator: Vanshika Gandhi, Mansi Pal, Vathsala Patil, Radhika Garg, Deepak Kumar Singhal, Archana M V, Adarsh Kudva, Yogesh Chhaparwal, Nanditha Sujir
pmc-13234147.description: BackgroundPediatric oncology patients are highly susceptible to oral complications during chemotherapy. Awareness amongst parents and oral hygiene practices play a crucial role in preventing and managing these issues.AimTo assess parental knowledge and awareness about the oral hygiene practices and reported oral manifestations associated with chemotherapy in pediatric oncology patients.

pmc-13303560.title: Characterization and outcomes of severe complications after autologous hematopoietic stem-cell transplantation: a retrospective multicenter study
pmc-13303560.creator: Corentin Le Cacheux, Mathilde Bastien, Aurélie Le Thuaut, Arthur Orieux, Léa Courtot-Melciolle, Muriel Picard, Mathilde Chanut, Frédéric Pène, Guillaume Dumas, Anne-Sophie Moreau, Quentin Quelven, Lara Zafrani, Emmanuel Canet

pmc-13387195.title: Factors Associated with the Acceptance of Weight Loss Drugs Among Overweight and Obese Adults in Mainland China: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13387195.creator: Wude Guo, Min Zhao, Yang Liu, Xin Zhang, Guoxiang Liu
pmc-13387195.description: ObjectiveWith the growing burden of overweight and obesity, weight-loss pharmacotherapy has emerged as an effective treatment option. However, patient acceptance remains a significant barrier to treatment uptake and adherence. This study investigated the acceptance of weight loss drugs (WLDs) among overweight and obese adults in mainland China, as well as related social-demographic, clinical, and psychosocial determinants.

pmc-13459939.title: Translation, adaptation, and validation of a Moroccan version of the H-SCALE (Hypertension Self-Care Activity Level effects) for hypertensive patients
pmc-13459939.creator: Manar Aarrad, Imane Barakat, Saad El Madani, Noureddine El Khoudri, Mohamed Chahboune, Aya Ikhelk, Imane Kabbach, Ouiam Yammad, Mohamed Hilal, Fatimazahra Laamiri
pmc-13459939.description: BackgroundHypertension is the leading cause of premature death worldwide and the primary risk factor for cardiovascular disease. Its management relies mainly on self-management practices by hypertensive patients. The Hypertension Self-Care Activity Level effects scale (H-SCALE) is one of the most widely used tools for assessing these practices.

pmc-13471371.title: Endovascular treatment versus standard medical management in primary M3 or M4 occlusion stroke in clinical practice: the oriental-MeVO registry
pmc-13471371.creator: Yuyou Zhu, Chao Zhang, HuiJia Yang, Chunrong Tao, Rui Li, XiaoZhong Jing, Li Wang, Tianlong Liu, Jianlong Song, HaiYing Hu, AnMo Wang, JinJing Wang, Wei Hu
pmc-13471371.description: BackgroundClinical evidence of the potential treatment benefit of endovascular treatment (EVT) for M3 occlusion of the middle cerebral artery (MCA) is sparse. This study aims to compare EVT versus standard medical management (SMM) for acute M3 and M4 occlusion stroke.

pmc-13559583.title: A SEER based SHAP interpretable prognostic nomogram for overall survival in surgically treated patients with colorectal cancer and synchronous liver metastasis
pmc-13559583.creator: Shaowei Jiang, Lulu Qi, Jiaqi Yuan, Haiyun Zhang
pmc-13559583.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundColorectal cancer (CRC) with liver metastasis is associated with poor prognosis and substantial heterogeneity in survival outcomes. Accurate risk stratification is essential for individualized treatment planning, yet reliable and interpretable prognostic tools remain limited.

pmc-13573459.creator: Yaoming Liu, Haiyue Rao, Nana Wang, Xiaoqing Liu, Tao Chen, Bin Zhang, Jintao Lai, Jianyu Shan, Shiqi Xiao, Haojie Peng, Yiqiang Zhu, Taizhen Liang, Sen Liu, Meilin Hu, Lixiang Xie, Guochang Qiu, Xiaobo Li, Yaxin Li, Xiancai Ma
